overview_description.description: Manifest OS is a legal technology company that provides infrastructure and operational support for law firms through a centralized platform and AI-based tools. The company offers services such as document drafting support, client communication management, billing, collections, and administrative operations, allowing attorneys to focus more on legal work. Its platform is designed to support law firms operating under a unified brand while maintaining independent legal practices. Manifest OS works with firms handling areas such as individual and corporate immigration law and provides fixed-fee and workflow management systems intended to improve transparency for clients. The company also employs teams across engineering, operations, legal operations, and product development to support its technology and service model.
